title: Piece of Junk
text: Piece of Junk. It's four o'clock in the afternoon and the clock says it's 1:30 in the morning. I followed all the instructions and it can't seem to get itself set to the correct time. I have other clocks like this and have absolutely no problem getting them set up.

product_metadata.title: MARATHON Atomic Travel Alarm Clock with Auto Night Light, Black - 12 or 24-Hour Time, Six Time Zones, Indoor Temperature, Date - One AAA Battery Included
features: SELF-SETTING, SELF-ADJUSTING CLOCK - Insert the battery provided & the Marathon Travel Atomic Alarm Clock will synchronize to the correct time using radio frequencies broadcast from NIST’s Colorado Atomic Clock (only functions in North America).
AUTOMATIC BACKLIGHT - This clock uses a built-in light sensor to detect if the clock has been placed in a dark environment. The backlight can also be manually operated.

INFORMATIVE DISPLAY - The easy-to-ready display includes the time in 12- or 24-hour format, the indoor room temperature in Celcius or Farenheit, and the month, date & day in English, French, German, Italian & Spanish.
LOUD ALARM - Easy to set up and use, the alarm is loud & clear.

FAMILY OWNED & OPERATED - Marathon has been manufacturing precision timing instruments since 1941. Today, they continue their legacy, combining modern design sensibility with Swiss engineering & craftsmanship to ensure the highest quality products.
